items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that cleans without stripping skin that looks dry and flaky.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to help comfort dry-looking skin and support the moisture barrier.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily protection, which skin on a drying regimen needs, and zinc oxide is usually well tolerated on sensitive skin.

response.routine_note: I have left out the glycolic toner and the vitamin C serum, because exfoliating acids and strong actives can be too harsh while your skin is this dry and sensitive, so please ask your prescriber or a dermatologist before adding them. Use the cleanser and cream morning and night, and finish with the SPF each morning.
